cohort: 285 newborns with RDS and 285 newborns without RDS, matched for birth time and month
finding: Maternal factors (inadequate antenatal care, preterm birth, caesarean section delivery, delivery after office hours) and infant factors (male sex, high birth weight) were associated with an increased risk of neonatal respiratory distress syndrome.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with a significantly increased risk of RDS (Adjusted OR=24.50; 95% CI: 14.83-40.47).
